_comment: Login Followed By Tool Transfer. Generated from rules/login_then_tool_transfer.yml by tools/build.py; do not edit.

properties.description: A session logs in and transfers a tool within the same five-minute window: the automated dropper chain of IoT and Linux botnets. Commands only exist after a login in Cowrie, so grouping by session gives the order without an ordered correlation (which the Splunk backend doesn't support). Buckets are fixed, so a chain that straddles a bucket boundary is missed; widen the timespan to trade precision for recall.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Login Followed By Tool Transfer from {{src_ip}}
